items.title: Introducing the Context Quality Score (CQS): a new framework for measuring and optimizing AI context
items.summary: After 25+ years partnering with customers to unlock teamwork, we’ve seen firsthand the hardest challenge isn’t executing the task, but connecting the right context to the flow of work. And as AI takes on more work, the advantage isn’t a smarter model but the context you feed it.
